This proposed amendment would revert back to the term "gametes" within many references to possession, transport, stocking or prohibitions of fish and fish eggs. 2026 Proposed Amendment to LD 2055

This proposal will add the term "milt" within many references to possession, transport, stocking or prohibitions related to fish and fish eggs. The term "gametes" is the scientific and biological general term for both fish eggs and milt and it was removed in a law change last session. The term gametes was replaced with fish eggs to utilize a more commonly recognized word but this inadvertently omitted fish milt which is just as important to regulate as fish eggs.

Testimony ofRep. Tiflany Roberts presenting
LD 2055, An Act to Amend or Correct Certain Island Fisheries and Wildlife
Laws
Before the Joint Standing Committee on Inland Fisheries and Wildlife

Good afternoon, Senator Baldacci, and esteemed members of the Joint Standing Committee on Inland Fisheries and Wildlife. I am Tiffany Roberts, and I represent House District 149, which
includes parts ofNo1'th and South Berwick. I am pleased to be here today to present LD 2055,
An Act to Amend or Correct Certain Island Fisheries and Wildlife Laws.
LD 2055 addresses three main issues:
It is correcting an error in the moose permit transfer law to ensure that disabled veteran recipients are subject to the standard 3-year waiting period before reapplying (rather than allowing them to reapply immediately, which was unintended).
It reorganizes and clarifies statutes on lead jigs and sinkers by removing the word "unpainted" from prohibited sales language and closing a regulatory gap between September 2025 and September 2026.
Additionally, it is requesting an amendment to restore the term "gametes" in fish regulation statutes to properly include both fish eggs and milt, which was inadvertently omitted in the last
sessi0n's law change.
I will defer to the department, who can present the bill in more detail and answer any questions you may have.
Thank you for your consideration.

District 149: Part of North Berwick and Part of South Berwick
